description: Image Description: The image shows a small, tiled restroom stall with two white partitioned toilet cubicles on either side. The floor is covered in small, square, blue tiles arranged in a grid pattern, and there is a circular drain visible near the back wall. The walls are tiled with larger, light-colored square tiles, and the space appears to be clean and well-maintained. In the foreground, lying diagonally across the floor, is a red and black tennis racket with a visible logo
